candidates.exact_span: The facility shall have a 1-year compliance schedule to achieve final limitations for Cyanide pollutant. The permit will require compliance schedule reports.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether interim compliance-schedule limitations versus final Cyanide limitations govern during Federal FY2025 affects which enforceable numeric limit applies (A) and whether compliance-schedule reporting is an applicable monitoring obligation (B).

candidates.exact_span: The preliminary toxic analysis, also, shows potential for RP to exist, based on insufficiently sensitive test methods used, for Cadmium, 2,3,7,8-TCDD Dioxin, Pentachlorophenol, Aldrin, Chlordane and Toxaphene pollutants.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Reasonable-potential findings tied to insufficient method sensitivity can change whether quarterly monitoring is treated as required (B) and whether absent or non-detect results reflect documented no-data/insufficient-evidence states rather than ordinary numeric compliance comparisons (C).

candidates.exact_span: Because the permittee has not met the sufficient sensitive test requirement per 40 CFR 122.21(e)(3), EPA proposes monitoring for these parameters quarterly n the draft permit.
candidates.computation_change_reason: The cited 40 CFR 122.21(e)(3) sensitivity failure is offered as the basis for proposed quarterly monitoring; interpreting whether that condition makes monitoring actually applicable changes B obligation determinations for the listed parameters.

candidates.exact_span: During the public comment period, the permittee may submit the analysis results using EPA approved methods with SSM complied MDL (shown in parenthesis) for Cadmium (0.05 ug/L, EPA 200.9) , 2,3,7,8-TCDD Dioxin (1.0E-5 ug/L, EPA 1613B), Pentachlorophenol (7.4 ug/L, EPA 604), Aldrin (0.004 ug/L, EPA 608), Chlordane (0.014 ug/L, EPA 608), and Toxaphene (0.24 ug/L, EPA 608)). EPA would reconsider this monitoring requirement for the final permit if the result(s) indicate no reasonable potential exists.
candidates.computation_change_reason: The specified EPA methods and MDLs can affect whether reported values are comparable to enforceable limits (A), whether alternative submitted analyses remove or sustain proposed monitoring obligations (B), and whether missing or below-MDL results reflect conditional non-requirement versus unresolved required monitoring (C).

candidates.exact_span: Pollutants that have the Navajo Nation WQS reported above MQL are Aluminum, Arsenic, Copper, Total Mercury, Nickel, Selenium, Zinc, Bis(2-ethylhexyl)Phthalate, Chloroform, Phenol, Cyanide and Arsenic.
candidates.computation_change_reason: The enumerated pollutant set defines which parameters are treated as having applicable WQS-based limits for downstream protection; different readings of scope or duplication in the list change which measurements receive numeric limit comparisons.
